observation_summary: interactive session: northstar iteration — PATH fix, watchlist expansion, parser fix, IDUNA auth
actions_taken: 1. Fixed observation-watcher to resolve claude CLI from ~/.local/bin when not on PATH (resolveCmd helper). This unblocks the autonomous Emily ↔ Claude feedback loop. 2. Expanded config/watchlist.json from 24 to 50 tickers across megacap tech, pharma, energy, retail, and industrials. Northstar Week-8 target of 50+ companies now met. 3. Fixed entity-graph parser: 'Against Abstained' and 'Broker Non-Vote' were being extracted as director names due to missing headerPhrases variants and no keyword guard. Added nonNameWords set and 3 regression tests. 4. Implemented internal/idunaauth package: stdlib-only ES256 JWT verifier backed by IDUNA JWKS endpoint. Wired into signalapi as optional middleware via IDUNA_JWKS_URL env var. 8 tests.
notes: All four changes pushed to PRRJECT_FATBABY main. EMILY and IDUNA repos surveyed — both clean with all tests passing. IDUNA admin UI complete. Emily Prime integration (git-based tasks/observations) operational. No further blocking issues identified for autonomous loop.
